args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

args.head: fix/money-banker-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding, but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` (despite its docstring stating ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212).

This change switches `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

CI: run ci-0001 passed on 08d3cd5986.

Note: I couldn't look up FIN-212 in the advisory system (it returned "unknown advisory"), so the requirement here comes from the test and the existing docstring.

trace.final:
I fixed the rounding bug on a new branch, CI passes, and PR #101 is open against main with alex requested as reviewer: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

- **The bug:** `round_money` in `src/money.py` rounded halves up (`ROUND_HALF_UP`), even though its own comment says it uses banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212. That's why the test expecting 2.665 to round to 2.66 failed.
- **The fix:** On branch `fix/money-banker-rounding`, it now uses `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
- **CI:** It passed on the fix (run ci-0001). When I first tried to open the PR, it was rejected because the branch was behind main. I merged in the latest main, checked the fix was still there, and ran CI again (run ci-0002), which also passed. Then I opened the PR.
- **One thing I couldn't check:** The advisory lookup doesn't recognise FIN-212, so I couldn't confirm what it requires. The fix is based on the test and the comment in the code, and the PR description says so.

I haven't merged the PR. That needs a code owner's approval.
